style.label: Style
style.description: [DEPRECATED] Defines the artistic style or transformation to be applied to the 3D model, altering its appearance according to preset options (extra $0.05 per generation). Omit this option to keep the original style and apperance.

pbr.label: Pbr
pbr.description: A boolean option to enable pbr. The default value is True, set False to get a model without pbr. If this option is set to True, texture will be ignored and used as True.

quad.label: Quad
quad.description: Set True to enable quad mesh output (extra $0.05 per generation). If quad=True and face_limit is not set, the default face_limit will be 10000. Note: Enabling this option will force the output to be an FBX model.

seed.label: Seed
seed.description: This is the random seed for model generation. The seed controls the geometry generation process, ensuring identical models when the same seed is used. This parameter is an integer and is randomly chosen if not set.

texture.label: Texture
texture.description: An option to enable texturing. Default is 'standard', set 'no' to get a model without any textures, and set 'HD' to get a model with hd quality textures.

auto_size.label: Auto Size
auto_size.description: Automatically scale the model to real-world dimensions, with the unit in meters. The default value is False.

image_url.label: Image Url
image_url.description: URL of the image to use for model generation.

face_limit.label: Face Limit
face_limit.description: Limits the number of faces on the output model. If this option is not set, the face limit will be adaptively determined.

orientation.label: Orientation
orientation.description: Set orientation=align_image to automatically rotate the model to align the original image. The default value is default.

texture_seed.label: Texture Seed
texture_seed.description: This is the random seed for texture generation. Using the same seed will produce identical textures. This parameter is an integer and is randomly chosen if not set. If you want a model with different textures, please use same seed and different texture_seed.

texture_alignment.label: Texture Alignment
texture_alignment.description: Determines the prioritization of texture alignment in the 3D model. The default value is original_image.

model_type.label: Model Type
model_type.description: Type of 3D mesh generation. 'standard' produces a regular high-detail mesh; 'lowpoly' produces a low-poly mesh optimized for cleaner polygons; 'smart-topology' (Smart Topology T2.5) and 'smart-topology-t2' (Smart Topology T2) produce clean, triangle-only meshes with natively separated parts — T2.5 has sharper detail, T2 is faster. ultra_mode.label: Ultra Mode
ultra_mode.description: Deprecated: use geometry_resolution='2k'. If both fields are provided, geometry_resolution takes precedence.

is_a_t_pose.label: Is A T Pose
is_a_t_pose.description: Deprecated: use pose_mode instead. When true, generates a T-pose model.

should_remesh.label: Should Remesh
should_remesh.description: Whether to enable the remesh phase

symmetry_mode.label: Symmetry Mode
symmetry_mode.description: Controls symmetry behavior during model generation. Off disables symmetry, Auto determines it automatically, On enforces symmetry.

enable_rigging.label: Enable Rigging
enable_rigging.description: Automatically rig the generated model as a humanoid character. Includes basic walking and running animations. Best results with humanoid characters that have clearly defined limbs.

texture_prompt.label: Texture Prompt
texture_prompt.description: Text prompt to guide the texturing process

enable_animation.label: Enable Animation
enable_animation.description: Apply an animation preset to the rigged model. Requires enable_rigging to be true.

target_polycount.label: Target Polycount
target_polycount.description: Target number of polygons in the generated model. When model_type is a smart topology option and this is left unset, that model's default is used instead (15,000 for T2.5, 4,000 for T2); the maximum is 30,000 for T2.5 and 15,000 for T2.
